games.name: The Long Drag
games.desc:
Crawl to Freedom

You’ve got no legs, no shortcuts, and no escape from the challenge ahead. In this simulator, your only way forward is to crawl, dragging yourself across the ground while chained to objects that get heavier and heavier as you progress.

Every inch you move takes effort. Every new zone adds tougher weights, harder terrain, and bigger obstacles to overcome. Upgrade your strength, unlock new crawling styles, and push your limits to reach the finish line.

Can you handle the grind, out-crawl the weight, and prove you're unstoppable?
